whyThisMember: The shipped renderer CSS is Tailwind-compiled and minified; the same token vocabulary also ships verbatim as a vanilla stylesheet string in the main-process bundle, which is the readable source of record chosen here.

files.note: Byte-for-byte the extracted sheet. Do not hand-edit: re-extract instead.

Generated by apps/desktop/scripts/extract-cds-components.mjs from the renderer CSS evidence below：只保留选择器点名 [data-cds=...] 的规则。两个变换：.cds-root→body[data-dsh-claude-style]；var(--cds-x)→var(--x)（仅当 vanilla 薄有同名公共令牌）。Do not hand-edit: re-run the extractor.
Per-component rule/declaration counts + source digest for the extraction above.
Cairn-specific ledger：每个 data-cds 组件逐条标 ported / no-cairn-counterpart / no-component-css 并写明原因；tests/cds-components.test.ts 校验集合与数量。

extraction.reproduce: tokens.css + 渲染层 CSS: python3 apps/desktop/scripts/extract-cds-tokens.py --check（只核对）/ --write src/renderer/vendor/cds-official --css-out <tmp>/MainWindowPage-*.css（落盘）; components.css: node apps/desktop/scripts/extract-cds-components.mjs <MainWindowPage-*.css> apps/desktop/src/renderer/vendor/cds-official

licensing.fonts: Anthropic Sans / Anthropic Serif ship as proprietary woff2 inside the app bundle with no license grant present; NOT vendored here. Cairn keeps its own OFL faces.
licensing.tokens: Token names and numeric values are facts about a public UI surface and are reproduced for interoperability/parity verification.
licensing.components: 官方组件规则（选择器点名 data-cds 的子集）逐条转录，用于互操作与一致性判卷；未收录编译产物的其余部分。

upstreamDrift.why: 上游会继续动这层；vendored 副本一旦落后就没有任何判卷会响（cds-parity.test.ts 只钉 vendored 自身与本记录一致）。
upstreamDrift.judge: apps/desktop/tests/cds-upstream-drift.test.ts（本机装了 Claude.app 时才判；缺席时明确记为未检，不等于通过）

evidence.why: The Tailwind-compiled renderer CSS is the only place that carries the per-scope size variants (`--cds-radius--sm`, `--cds-font-size-body--own`, ...). Values quoted from it in tests are read here, not remembered.
